name: Chromatic Image
body:
School illusion; Level bard 5, magus 6, mesmerist 6, occultist 6, psychic 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell operates as mirror image except you and the images shift in color. Whenever a foe destroys an image, they are dealt 1d6 plus your caster level in damage. Half of the damage is the damage type rolled on the table at the bottom of page 39, the other half is psychic damage caused by the flashing color that is not subject to resistance. However, if the target is immune to mind?affecting, they are immune to that half of the damage. Re-roll any results of 8 rolled on the table to determine the damage type.
